subject: Arsenal: comparative economics, runtime fit & onboarding gaps
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@arsenal.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@arsenal.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood econ + runtime compatibility questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — Arsenal's execs liked the latency profile and the observability demo. Before we proceed to legal, procurement asked for a short write-up comparing your cost/packaging vs our incumbent (HelioScale) and to understand what you can do on the economics and onboarding side to make a swap predictable.

Specifically:
- A head-to-head 12-month spend comparison with the HelioScale offer they provided (we attached their redlined quote).
- Practical migration credits or upfront buckets you can offer to offset egress & integration work.
- A short pilot plan (3–6 weeks) with target SLOs we can rely on to validate runtime parity.

I've attached a spreadsheet with procurement's questions. Can you get back with a short concession template and a pilot checklist? Evan

Attachments: Arsenal_Retention_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

---
Arsenal AI
Evan Brooks | Head of Platform
evan.brooks@arsenal.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood econ + runtime compatibility questions

Looping you both in — Arsenal wants a concise comparative and a pilot + concession template. Quick thoughts below; Monica can you drop concrete numbers? Lauren, we may need a short ops-runbook for the pilot.

High-level options to consider (we should present 2–3 alternatives):
1) Credit-first: 3 months of runtime credits (applied to first 6 months) + 25% token discount for first 12 months. Lower upfront margin hit but strong near-term unit economics for them.
2) Prepay + performance rebate: 6-month prepay at 10% off list with a performance rebate tied to 95th percentile token latency during pilot.
3) Hybrid migration bucket: fixed $60k migration credit + accelerated onboarding with an assigned Solutions Engineer and a one-time integration discount.

Pilot ask: 4–6 weeks, dataset parity test, 95th p99 latency targets within 10% of HelioScale's numbers, and two-day turn for triage on any regressions.

Monica — can you materialize the numbers and the short concession doc (xlsx + PDF)? Lauren — can you sketch the pilot runbook (ops tasks, telemetry hooks, rollback criteria)? 

Thanks,
Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 12:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood econ + runtime compatibility questions

+1 to the three-option approach. I prepared a quick slate of concession options and a spreadsheet with unit math. See key rows below — I'll attach the full file (concession_options.xlsx).

Concession options (summary):
A) Light: 25% token discount for 12 months; no migration credit; 30% cap on seat/feature discounts. Estimated FY1 net impact: ~6.2% ARR erosion vs list.
B) Moderate (recommended for mid-market close): $60,000 migration credit (invoice credit), 30% token discount for first 6 months then 15% thereafter; one assigned SE for 6 weeks. Estimated FY1 impact: ~11% ARR erosion but materially lowers churn risk.
C) Aggressive (for high-risk logo): $120,000 migration credit + 3 months free runtime credits + 35% token discount first 12 months; SLA uplift (faster routing) as part of Dedicated capacity pilot. Estimated FY1 impact: ~18% ARR erosion; requires leadership approval.

Pilot framework: 4–6 weeks with three milestones — intake & benchmark (week 1), parity validation (weeks 2–4), go/no-go runbook + ops handoff (week 5–6). KPI targets: throughput, 95th p99 token latency, and end-to-end error rate <0.5%. Deliverables: benchmark report, buglist with severity tags, and an exec-summary.

Attachments: concession_options.xlsx (13KB)

Monica

Monica Patel
Sr. Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@arsenal.ai>
Cc: procurement@arsenal.ai, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 14:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood econ + runtime compatibility questions

Evan — appreciate the clear ask and the spreadsheet. We've put together a concise offer and a pilot plan that aligns to procurement's checklist. High level below; full PDF attached.

Offer (pick one of three):
- Moderate (recommended): $60k migration credit applied as invoice credit; 30% token discount first 6 months, 15% thereafter through month 12; one SE assigned for 6 weeks; 6-week pilot with guaranteed telemetry hooks and a performance validation report.
- Light: 25% token discount 12 months; pilot with standard SE support (2 weeks).
- Aggressive: $120k migration credit, 3 months runtime credits, 35% token discount 12 months, SLA uplift on Dedicated route for pilot (requires Exec sign-off).

Pilot summary: 6-week program — intake, benchmark, parity validation, and operations handoff. We commit to a 95th percentile token latency target within 10% of the HelioScale baseline during the parity validation window; if we miss that target, we will apply an additional 10% credit against the first invoice as remediation (pilot-only remediation).

Next steps:
1) Confirm which concession option Arsenal prefers.
2) If Moderate or Aggressive, sign the attached short concession Addendum (DocuSign link below).
3) Agree pilot dates and dataset handoff (we aim to start the pilot within 10 business days of signed addendum).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/ARS-2027-0042-offer
Attachments: redwood-comparative-econ.pdf (8 pages), concession_options.xlsx, Arsenal_Retention_Questions.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk the team through the pilot runbook.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
